title: Tracker integrity prints record text to the job log, where the runner parses it as workflow commands (OPAG-971)
description: Reported by opum-agent as OPAG-971 (CI hygiene), 2026-09-30. The Tracker integrity workflow ran `bun run src/cli/main.ts task list --json` unredirected in its "Tracker reads cleanly" step, printing every record field to the job log. The Actions runner parses log lines that begin with workflow-command syntax, so record text controls the log: lore-cli measured this class at 846233e1, where a green job carried a failure-level annotation because a record note quoted a CI log line starting with the error-command prefix; the same mechanism covers add-mask and stop-commands. Record notes legitimately quote log excerpts, so this is an injection surface and an accidental-annotation generator at once. Fix: redirect the listing under $RUNNER_TEMP and print only a count, mirroring the fix landed in opum-ai/opum-agent#1662; the exit code keeps gating and the count is the positive control.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The Tracker integrity job prints no record text to its log: the task-list step writes the listing under $RUNNER_TEMP and prints a count line, verified by reading the green run log.

With a record carrying text the runner would parse as a workflow command (a line beginning with the error-command prefix), the job runs green with 0 annotations on the check run; the pre-fix behavior of the same text is on record from lore-cli 846233e1.
An empty or malformed listing fails the step rather than reading as zero records (the jq count gates).

plan: 1. Redirect the task-list step under $RUNNER_TEMP and print a count as the positive control, with a comment naming the workflow-command parsing reason.
2. Verify on the PR: green job, 0 annotations, count line in the log.
3. Negative control on the branch: plant a record note containing workflow-command text, confirm 0 annotations, then revert the plant before merge.
4. PR, required contexts green, squash-merge to dev; reply to opum-agent with the PR.
implementationNotes: MEASURED 2026-09-30 (session 08e30ebe) on this PR runs, opum-ai/quest-cli#471. PRE-FIX REPRODUCTION (head f6410a2, old step, fixture planted): exactly 1 failure-level annotation on a job that concluded success; the annotation message is a 4097-byte slice of the task-list JSON immediately following a command token, and the retrieved job log renders the step output as one bracket-form error line with no literal double-colon token surviving -- which is also why lore-cli described what they saw as a bracket-quoting log line. NATURAL EXPERIMENT, pre-fix, real tree: records QCLI-247 and QCLI-317 already carry mid-line double-colon tokens (quoted log text) and were printed by the promotion run on 08d2fa7d, which carried 0 annotations -- so the bare double-colon form mid-line does not fire; the bracket form is scanned anywhere in a line. ACCEPT MEASUREMENT (head 53002be, fixed step, fixture still planted): 0 annotations, 0 occurrences of the fixture text in the job log, and the count line reads "read 427 task record(s)" -- the same count a local run of the step body produced. CONTROL CORRECTION: the echoed-substitution shape `read $(jq ...)` does not gate -- measured under bash, empty, malformed and zero-record inputs all exit 0 printing a blank count; the landed form assigns from `jq -er` with `select(. > 0)` and fails those inputs 4, 4 and 5.
finalSummary: QCLI-430 done, delivered by opum-ai/quest-cli#471. The Tracker integrity job no longer prints record text: the listing is redirected under $RUNNER_TEMP and the step prints only a record count. Verified as a pair on the PR own runs: pre-fix head f6410a2 with a planted record note produced 1 failure-level annotation on a job that concluded success; fix head 53002be with the same note still planted ran with 0 annotations, 0 occurrences of the note text in the job log, and the count line "read 427 task record(s)". Tracker integrity run 36790173571 validated 53002be, with all three required contexts green on that head. The count control shape is load-bearing and recorded in the workflow comment: the echoed-substitution variant silently exits 0 on empty, malformed and zero-record input, while the landed assignment form fails all three (4, 4, 5).
